      public static DMLConfig readConfigurationFile(String configPath) throws FileNotFoundException
      Start with the internal default settings, then merge in the settings from any specified configuration file, if available. If it is not explicitly given, then merge in settings from the default configuration file location, if available.
      Parameters:
      configPath - User-defined path of the configuration file.
      Returns:
      dml configuration
      Throws:
      FileNotFoundException - if FileNotFoundException occurs
